summary: Voice Notes feature tested. Backend /api/transcribe passes all 4 required tests: WAV multipart returns 200 with {text: str}; real gTTS speech clip transcribed to non-empty text containing expected keywords ('twist words'); empty body -> 400; oversize (>25 MB) -> 413. All existing endpoints (POST /api/analyze text+image, POST/GET/DELETE /api/history) still pass. Total 12/12 pytest cases green. Frontend: 3-tab segment (Paste/Screenshots/Voice) renders correctly on mobile viewport; tapping Voice reveals the voice-web-unavailable fallback card with fully readable colors (title #fafafa on #18181b background, body #a1a1aa — high contrast). Paste -> Analyse -> Scorecard end-to-end verified (scorecard rendered with correct dual gauges and verdict). The Save-to-History regression from iteration_2 (react-native-svg `origin` prop causing 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' error and spawning an Expo LogBox that intercepts save-btn taps) is STILL PRESENT and blocks the final Save step on web preview — the main agent's iteration_2 action item was not applied.

ui_bugs.issue: STILL UNRESOLVED from iteration_2: `origin` string prop on <Circle>/<AnimatedCircle> forwards as DOM attribute `transform-origin` -> React console.error -> Expo LogBox overlay covers the sticky CTA on /scorecard, intercepting Save/Share taps on web preview. Save-to-History flow could not be completed on web (history remained empty after tap).

integration_issues.issue: Save button tap does not persist to /api/history because the react-native-svg `transform-origin` warning triggers an Expo LogBox overlay that captures pointer events on the sticky CTA bar. Native platforms unaffected. Save button IS present (testID visible) and reachable — only the tap event is intercepted.

react_native_issues.issue: `origin={`${SIZE/2}, ${SIZE/2}`}` prop is not web-safe. Replace with `originX={SIZE/2} originY={SIZE/2}` (or wrap in a rotated <G>) to eliminate the DOM warning. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/dual-gauge.tsx (both <Circle> and <AnimatedCircle> occurrences).

Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Likely inside VoiceRecorder's <Animated.View pointerEvents="none"> and possibly other components — move to style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}.

This clears the LogBox and unblocks Save-to-History on web preview. (Repeat of iteration_2 action item — not applied yet.)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend transcribe endpoint fully verified — no regressions expected. Frontend Voice tab is intentionally read-only on web (fallback card) per spec; on-device recording can only be tested via Expo Go. The one open bug (react-native-svg `origin` prop -> LogBox overlay blocking scorecard Save/Share taps on web) is a REPEAT of iteration_2's finding and was not fixed. To fully clear the E2E Paste-flow on web, apply the two-line change in dual-gauge.tsx: `originX={SIZE/2} originY={SIZE/2}` on both circles. `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` env var must be exported before running pytest (frontend/.env is not auto-loaded for backend tests). Run: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`.
rca_of_issue: Save-to-History on web: root cause is unchanged from iteration_2. react-native-svg-web forwards the string `origin` prop verbatim as the DOM attribute `transform-origin`; React 19 flags this as an invalid DOM property and calls `console.error`, which Expo's LogBox surfaces as a bottom-of-screen overlay. That overlay swallows pointer events on the sticky CTA in /scorecard, so the Save tap never reaches the Pressable. Reproduction: navigate to /scorecard on web -> observe red toast -> tap Save -> body no longer contains 'Saved' and GET /api/history returns []. Mitigation: replace `origin` with `originX`/`originY` numeric props on both Circle/AnimatedCircle in dual-gauge.tsx.
